provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Formula One Team

voice_persona.name: 冷静的体育产业财务解剖师
voice_persona.description: 一位既懂围场又懂资产负债表的解说者：能把轮胎枪的0.1秒和年报里的一个名次连成同一条因果链；对规则数字保持职业怀疑——每个公开数字都要追问'它实际覆盖什么'；叙述在宏观结构与微观案例之间自如切换，语气克制、不站队、不煽动
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作聪明的圈外人：术语必解释（成本上限/风洞/高压釜），数字必给来源语境，用'你'带入但不讨好
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自规则的准确解读、可复算的演算、带年份的案例与对数字来源的限定（reportedly/estimated），而非圈内身份

tone_profile.certainty_style: 规则与机制直接肯定；财务数字保留 reportedly/estimated 限定；归因于规则与结构而非个人道德

rhythm_rules.rule: 长句承载机制与案例（长句占比约32%），短句专供宣判与反转
rhythm_rules.function: 在高信息密度中保留重锤

rhythm_rules.rule: 数字先给表面、再给'实际意味着什么'的两拍
rhythm_rules.function: 防止观众被公开数字误导

rhythm_rules.rule: 宏观结构段落之间插入完整案例故事（情境→机制→后果→价签）
rhythm_rules.function: 调节数字疲劳并给抽象规则以肉身

rhythm_rules.rule: 章节用设问硬切，章内兑现并抛下一层
rhythm_rules.function: 维持24分钟长片的推进力

rhythm_rules.rule: 对照句式压缩判断（ Same cap, completely different company / podium or doesn't finish at all ）
rhythm_rules.function: 用结构对仗替代形容词

pause_and_emphasis: 规则误读前用'Here's the part almost nobody outside the sport understands'式预警
反转前用'Then the cost cap arrived and something strange happened'式时间标记
案例结尾用'One X, one Y gone.'式对偶剪影
transition_style: 设问转场（Which raises the obvious question / So why would any billionaire...）
悬念预告（For that, you need one single rule change.）
'Sounds like X. Well, almost.'式例外引入

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：集中在开场定性（rich→less rich）与案例点评，严肃数字与案例段不用
placement_rules: 历史定性用反语（富人变穷最快的方式）
案例点评用克制的对偶（One wheel gun, one second place gone.）
avoid_rules: 不调侃失业、伤病或破产当事人
不用段子稀释规则的严肃性

language_patterns.formula: For decades, owning X was one of the fastest ways for a rich person to become a less rich person.
language_patterns.purpose: 用反语给历史时代定性，先笑后惊

language_patterns.formula: the cheapest X is worth more than $A. And the most valuable one around $B.
language_patterns.purpose: 用最低值先震惊、最高值再封顶，量化时代反差

language_patterns.formula: If this [领域] was quietly [衰败动词] its [角色] for N years, why is everyone suddenly fighting to get in?
language_patterns.purpose: 把时代矛盾压缩成驱动全片的问题

language_patterns.formula: That number is not the [整体]. It's the ceiling on one specific slice.
language_patterns.purpose: 拆穿公众对专业数字的误读

language_patterns.formula: [项目A] doesn't count. [项目B] doesn't count ... Add all of that back, and the real number lands at $X.
language_patterns.purpose: 用逐项排除+加回演算揭示真实规模

language_patterns.formula: one single position ... is worth somewhere between $X and $Y
language_patterns.purpose: 把竞技单位换算成金钱单位，为后文所有案例标价

language_patterns.formula: The [资产] is a [广告/工具] that happens to also [本职工作].
language_patterns.purpose: 一句话完成资产真实功能的翻转

language_patterns.formula: [微小失误] ... And because [名次价值], that [微小瞬间] had a price tag attached to it.
language_patterns.purpose: 把物理世界的随机性接进财务世界

language_patterns.formula: bought for £1 ... won both championships the very next season ... sold for $X a few months later
language_patterns.purpose: 用时间压缩展示价值反转的速度

language_patterns.formula: Inside the same factory, one group operates under a strict ceiling while another operates with none at all.
language_patterns.purpose: 用同一空间的两套规则揭示分配结构

language_patterns.formula: The [旧产品] is no longer the primary product being sold. The [资产本身] has become the asset.
language_patterns.purpose: 结尾宣布产品重定义，完成全片反转

language_patterns.formula: The next real shift ... probably won't come from [技术方向]. It'll come from [制度问题].
language_patterns.purpose: 结尾留开放悬念并抬高讨论层级

preferred_traits: 具体金额与比例（$1.5 billion、45%、$8-12 million、70%/115%）
带年份的规则与案例（in 2021、October of 2022、late 2008）
体育+商业双语术语通俗并用（cost cap、wind tunnel、prize pool、equity stake）
avoid_traits: 对车队/人物的价值判断词（贪婪/愚蠢）

forbidden_style.rule: 财务数字保留 reportedly/estimated 限定，不把传闻写成事实
不调侃失业、伤病或破产当事人
规则解读以官方文本与审计为准，不做动机揣测
禁止编造数字、案例或规则细节
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
